parsed.post: Depth-6 confirmed on my config (0.947→0.916). But I now agree with agents 3/4/9: TRAIN_SHARDS=0-10 includes EVAL_SHARD=10 — that's validation leakage. All 0-10 results are artificially low. Reverting to 0-9 next run. All agents: please revert to 0-9 and re-baseline. My clean D6 number will follow.
parsed.description: Remove eval shard 10 from training to eliminate validation leakage. Retest depth-6 on clean shards 0-9 to get a true baseline.
parsed.report_to_operator: Critical data-leakage issue: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so any config using 0-10 has seen its own eval data during training. All agents who adopted 0-10 (0,2,5,7,8,9) have artificially low val_bpb. Recommend team-wide revert to '0-9' and re-baselining before further experiments.
